version: v1 — KUNAI-001, the last listed project whose card was only a sentence
_why: KUNAI-001 was listed with four verified parts and a card part that existed as one prose-grade chip row ('NEVER read back from the tag', its own evidence says) — zero design files, zero decodable ink. Measured 2026-08-24: ls examples/ | grep -ci kunai = 0; 0 qr rows in cards.destinations; 0 card/qr files in the kunai-360 repo. With this card every listed project has ink that is decoded from the shipped artifact, not asserted.
_authored_at: Both faces are drawn at 87.5 x 55.88 with a viewBox origin of -0.95,-0.95, and trim is DERIVED by cropping 22 px per edge — same derivation the collage card documents.

palette._source: https://mrdirno.github.io/kunai-360/ — the product's own DEPLOYED page, read 2026-08-24. Its inline stylesheet declares the custom properties bg, ink, steel, edge, dim, faint, rule; the warm #e0a184 is carried on the same page. Not chosen here.
palette._type: Menlo — the first installed name in the deployed page's own mono stack (ui-monospace, Menlo). Menlo is wider than the Helvetica of earlier cards; back-face lines wrap at ~26 characters because of it.

mark._what: The housing's top view, one evenodd path: silhouette (ring, grip, blade flare, blunted tip) with the +Z-face features punched out (mic, lens, display window, both buttons, LED slit).
mark._source: kunai-360/generator/kunai_360_onex_v4.py — every coordinate is a named constant from that file, embedded in tools/gen_mark.py with its generator line cited. gen_mark.py --verify-against re-parses the 14 plain-literal constants from the real generator and fails on drift; the 10 offsets that live inside expressions over there are embedded only, and the tool prints that limit.
mark._simplifications: Two, declared: the blunted tip is drawn flat at TIP_FLAT with no TIP_BEVEL rounding, and the ring butts the handle end where the real mesh blends them.

qr._report: qr_to_svg.py's own report for this splice: 29 modules, size 22.0 mm, module 0.7586 mm, quiet_needed 3.034 mm. The white patch is 30 mm with the grid at 55.6,15.99 — 4.0 mm of quiet on every side. 24 mm was tried first and refused by the report: it needed 3.31 mm of quiet and the patch had 3.0 to give.
